The primary color palette is dominated by warm light grey and earthy taupe tones, subtly complemented by muted gold or bronze accents, creating a harmonious and opulent feel. Key materials include luxurious polished grey marble, smooth light grey painted walls, and organic beige textured plaster, adding depth and tactile richness. The space is characterized by an open-plan layout, clean architectural lines, and a minimalist aesthetic, fostering a serene and expansive atmosphere. Natural wood elements are thoughtfully integrated to introduce warmth and a touch of organic texture. Soft, diffused lighting, with an average color temperature of 3390K, bathes the interior in a tranquil glow, enhancing the overall sense of calm, high-end comfort, and timeless sophistication. Every detail contributes to an understated yet undeniably luxurious environment.
